channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: How ‘inclusive’ culture brought an All-America pass rusher to Mankato
item.description: Marcus Hansen said he found a home at Minnesota State University, Mankato after a private Christian college ousted him.

item.title: Big rig truck driver embraces freedom, endures loneliness on the road
item.description: Lual Akoon, a refugee from South Sudan, drives an 18-wheeler across the country and into Canada but calls Minnesota home.

item.title: Rubio says US will press change in Venezuela with oil embargo, while Trump insists ‘we’re in charge’
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio suggested Sunday that the United States would not govern Venezuela day-to-day other than enforcing an existing “oil quarantine” on the country.

item.title: Analysis: Vikings wrap up key subplots in season finale, but leave a big cliffhanger
item.description: The Vikings executed plans to honor Harrison Smith, C.J. Ham and Justin Jefferson during a 16-3 win over the Packers, but questions about J.J. McCarthy remain unanswered.

item.title: Jennifer McDermed to leave Fox 9 after eight years
item.description: The meteorologist announced she is moving to California to be closer to family.

item.title: Hortman children condemn Trump post promoting false theory about their parents’ killing
item.description: Colin and Sophie Hortman are asking President Trump to remove a video he shared and to apologize.

item.title: Gophers get Tennessee tackle Bennett Warren in transfer portal
item.description: Eastern Michigan linebacker Andrew Marshall also will join the program.

item.title: Souhan: Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy ends the season on the sideline, with a lot to prove
item.description: McCarthy, still bothered by an injured right hand, bowed out of his last chance this season to impress his coaches and Vikings fans.

item.title: Minnesotans say they will miss the ‘stress-free’ Northstar as train takes its last ride
item.description: The commuter rail ended service after 16 years on Jan. 4.

item.title: Gov. Tim Walz calls impromptu news conference amid questions about his future
item.description: Walz has faced national scrutiny over fraud in state programs, and a growing number of Democrats have privately expressed concern about his run for a third term.
